data_notes: percent_owned and percent_started are ESPN-wide percentages, not WFFL-specific roster rates.
Weekly stats are included only where espn-api supplies them; keys may include actual and projected scores.
Activity records are returned by ESPN; bid fields are included only when exposed.
The snapshot does not guarantee access to unsuccessful waiver bids or complete transaction history.
Matchup projected scores may be absent depending on espn-api version and ESPN response.
